title: Separate runtime dispatch safety from final completion authority
dependency_semantics: runtime lock implementation and zero-write safety only; protected completion authority is not a prerequisite
acceptance: Pre-dispatch validation requires the exact merged runtime lock implementation, writer registry, lock order, source digests, and zero-write safety only.
A missing PANTHEON_RUNTIME_LOCK_VERIFIER_POLICY, completion.json, Ed25519 signature, revocation record, or ledger entry does not prevent primary catalog materialization.
LOOP-PROD-CLOSE-002 is the only task allowed to install and consume the protected completion authority.
Final closeout remains fail-closed for missing, wrong-head, revoked, replayed, stale, self-signed, or incorrectly bound verdicts.
The catalog remains 48 primary tasks with an acyclic dependency graph and exact digest rebinding.
The fleet PR has required checks, exact merged head, distinct reviewer evidence, and a checksummed evidence manifest.
proof_required: pre-dispatch materialization test without final signing authority
final closeout negative matrix for policy and signature failures
exact catalog and dispatcher digest rebinding
merged PR and independent exact-head review
non_goals: No dispatcher apply or live-capital/broker side effect
dispatch_rules: Fleet implementation only in a clean task worktree.
Owner and reviewer must be distinct admitted fleet identities.
Planner may inspect and accept evidence but may not implement declared artifacts.
Human/Ops authority is required only by LOOP-PROD-CLOSE-002, never by pre-dispatch materialization.
